title: fix(plugin-dashboard): a dataset-less `provider: 'object'` metric widget draws the retired-format placeholder on both surfaces (objectui#11525)
body:
Fixes #11525

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

The maintainer's ruling C on objectui#11525 (record `5964914121`) retires one stored widget form. The form is a dataset-less single-value widget whose `options.data` (or widget-level `data`) is `{ provider: 'object', … }`. The single-value family is `metric`, `gauge`, `solid-gauge`, `kpi` and `bullet`, plus a typeless widget, which resolves to `metric` since objectui#11514.

- **Both surfaces.** The metric arms of `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout` now return the shared `LEGACY_RETIRED_WIDGET_SCHEMA`. It is the same imported object the pivot arms already return for that input (objectui#10528).
- **The producer is gone.** The flat `object-metric` node both arms used to build is removed. That node carried an ObjectQL-dialect `filter` that no node type declares.
- **What does not move.** The inline chart and table arms are untouched. No zod or TS authoring face moves.

Implemented by the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat's dev, session `session_01XvhGmGAP79ZB8swnkapxPC`, under the PM claim `5965174453`.

## Before and after, per surface

The before/after run went through the real `SchemaRenderer` and real registrations. The adapter's `aggregate` answers 4242 and `queryDataset` answers 510000. "Before" is base `9d7419b9`; "after" is this branch.

| surface | widget | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DashboardRenderer` | `metric`, provider `options.data` | "Pipeline 4,242", 1 `aggregate` call | the placeholder, 0 calls |
| `DashboardRenderer` | `kpi`, same data | heading "Pipeline", then "Pipeline 4,242" | heading "Pipeline", then the placeholder, 0 calls |
| `DashboardRenderer` | no `type`, same data | "Pipeline 4,242", 1 call | the placeholder, 0 calls |
| `DashboardRenderer` | `pivot`, same data (control) | heading "Deals", then the placeholder | unchanged |
| `DashboardRenderer` | `metric` bound to a dataset (control) | "Revenue 510000", 1 `queryDataset` call | unchanged |
| `DashboardGridLayout` | the same five rows | the same readings as above | the same readings as above |

The placeholder text is "This widget uses a retired data format. Edit it to bind a dataset."

**Chrome, measured (the dispatch's H2).** The tile's chrome follows the widget's family, not the placeholder.

- A dataset-less `metric` (and a typeless widget) is self-contained on both surfaces, so its tile draws the placeholder without the widget's heading. That is the same tile the retired top-level `object` metric shape already drew, and a pin holds the two DOMs equal.
- `gauge`, `solid-gauge`, `kpi` and `bullet` take the Card chrome, so their heading is drawn above the placeholder, as the pivot's is.
- I did not change the chrome. Doing so would also move the legacy-shape metric's tile, which no ruling covers. This is listed under Acceptance notes and in the report's open question.

## What stays, and why: the filter broadcast's `object-metric` member

`DashboardRenderer`'s `FilterableComponentType` / `FILTERABLE_COMPONENT_TYPES` keeps `object-metric`. The member is not dead after the producer goes, measured:

- An author's legacy `component` envelope holding an `object-metric` node still reaches the merge.
- The filter bar scopes it today. A probe got `filter: { region: 'EMEA' }` on that node, for both an untyped and a `custom` envelope.
- Dropping the member would silently stop that, which the ruling did not ask for.

Its docblock now says so, and a pin holds it. `DashboardGridLayout` has no filter bar, so it has no such plumbing.

## The pins

The pins are in `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/inlineObjectMetricRetired-11525.test.tsx`: 29 tests, both surfaces.

- **Subjects.** Each single-value type with provider `options.data` is read off `METRIC_LIKE_TYPES`, not restated. Widget-level `data` and a typeless widget are cases too. Each draws `LEGACY_RETIRED_WIDGET_SCHEMA`, checked by identity on the recorded node. The test also reads the placeholder text on screen, finds no `object-metric` node, and sees no `aggregate`, `find` or `queryDataset` call. One more case holds that the retired `metric` tile's DOM equals the retired legacy-shape metric tile's.
- **Controls.** The provider pivot draws the same placeholder object, and a dataset-bound metric draws "510000". A static metric draws its `options.value` through `plugin-dashboard:metric`. A provider bar still builds an `object-chart` node naming `deal`, and a provider table still builds `object-data-table` and fetches. An envelope `object-metric` receives `{ region: 'EMEA' }` from the filter bar and queries.

**Reverse verification.** The fix was committed first (`856f56f0`). The two producer files were then checked out at `9d7419b9`, with a trap restoring them from `HEAD`.

- **Before running.** On disk, the base `object-metric` producer lines were 2 in `DashboardRenderer.tsx` and 1 in `DashboardGridLayout.tsx`. The renderer's 2 are the producer and the kept union member. The retired-arm marker read 0 and 0.
- **Result.** The run gave **16 failed, 13 passed (29)**. The failures are every subject (8 per surface); the passes are every control. This is the direction stated in the file header.
- **Restore.** The restored blob hashes equal `HEAD`'s, `git diff HEAD` on both files is 0 bytes, and the rerun is 29 passed.

## Corpus re-judged (H3)

**The census.** I ran `git grep` over the whole tracked tree for a file that pairs a `provider: 'object'` literal with a metric-family `type`. It found no test, fixture, story or example that authors a dataset-less inline provider metric through a dashboard surface or asserts its number. The hits are prose, CHANGELOGs, this card's own files, and two plugin-dashboard tests whose provider widget is a `bar`.

The full plugin-dashboard suite was green before this branch's pins were added. Verdicts:

- `DashboardGridLayout.legacyRetired.test.tsx`: its header said the nested provider config is live for every family. It gets a dated note. Its provider control is a `bar`, so the control stands as written.
- `DashboardGridLayout.datasetPath.test.tsx`, `widgetDataProviderRetired-7353.test.tsx`, `dashboard-producer-node-types-11514.test.tsx` and the three `DashboardChart.*` files: these are provider `bar`, `table` or `pivot` widgets, all live or already retired. Left alone.
- `DashboardRenderer.legacyRetired.test.tsx`: it covers the top-level `object` shape only. Left alone.
- Docs. `content/docs/guide/dashboard-filters.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` each get one paragraph naming the form that now draws the prompt. In `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`, the filters example's comment does the same, and the accent table's "inline `object-metric`" now reads "an `object-metric` block".
- Comments falsified by this change: `legacyRetiredWidget.ts` (the dated, append-only correction the ruling names), `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx`'s `aggregate` docblock (it said both relays compose this node), and the render-site and broadcast comments in the two surfaces.

## Pending changesets

- **New entry.** `.changeset/11525-inline-metric-retired.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`: `minor`) states the render change: what the tile showed before, what it shows now, and the fix, which is to bind a dataset.
- **Dated note.** `.changeset/11514-dashboard-slot-entry-types.md` gets one: its "Every widget that names a known family draws as before" no longer holds for this form. Its frontmatter is unchanged.
- **Left alone, and why.** I read every pending entry that names the inline provider, `object-metric`, `ObjectMetricWidget`, `legacyRetiredWidget`, objectui#4612, objectui#10528, objectui#11479 or the filter broadcast.
  - `11348-dashboard-widget-reads` still holds: the type guard still covers the same three `object-*` types.
  - `10528-grid-object-table-fetch` and `7353-retire-widget-dataprovider` cover the table and pivot only.
  - The `object-metric` block entries (`8613`, `8970`, `9002`, `10221`, `10356`, `10572`, `10993`, `11254`, `11444`, `11475`, `7352`, `7752`, `11506`) describe the widget, which stays live as an authored block. None says a dataset-less provider widget reaches it.
  - `check:changeset-claims` named three entries for files this branch edits: `11483-metric-card-needs-value`, `8114-detail-tab-activity-timeline` and `8760-unfulfilled-chart-stubs`. Their paragraphs concern `metric-card`, a detail tab and `line-chart`, which this branch does not move.

## V1 census (H4)

This was a throwaway worktree detached at PR #11512's head `ff7f748e`. I applied `git merge-tree` of that head and this branch, which had one conflict, `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`; I took V1's side because no plugin-dashboard program reads that file. After a fresh install and a closure build, I ran plugin-dashboard's two programs. Nothing was committed or pushed from the probe, and the probe was removed.

- **As is, with this change:** 4 lines per program (8 in all), only the four `SchemaRenderer` cast sites, two in each surface.
- **With the probe-only annotation that types both `getComponentSchema` returns as the renderer prop:**
  - **Base producers:** 12 lines per program. That is 5 `object-metric` lines (3 in `DashboardRenderer`, 2 in `DashboardGridLayout`), 2 `plugin-dashboard:metric`, 1 static `pivot` and the 4 casts.
  - **This branch:** 7 lines per program, with `object-metric` at **0**. Left are 2 `plugin-dashboard:metric`, 1 static `pivot` and the 4 casts, which belong to objectui#11466.

## Gates

Read at `29b4ab28` unless stated. objectui has no `dispatch-gates.mjs`; the list is hand-derived from `package.json`.

- **Closure build.** `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...' build` exited 0 under the verify lock.
- **`pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard run type-check`** exited 0. The script echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. The test program covers the new pin file: its first run failed on that file's case-table typing, which was then fixed.
- **`pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/`** (from the worktree root): 165 files and 1620 tests passed, 6 skipped. This ran at `a1c7e645`; the only later change is the pin file's stub registration, whose own rerun gave 29 passed.
- **Readers of the touched files, 29 test files:** 720 passed. They are the doc readers, `sdui-parser`'s options census, the app-shell `DashboardView` and preview suites, the console drill-down suites, the schema-catalog gallery render and the widget DOM-leak sweep.
- **Light gates, all exit 0:**
  - `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.
  - `check:control-bytes`, `check:doc-types` and `check-changeset-no-major`.
  - `check-changeset-presence`: 1 changeset for 6 published source files.
  - `check:changeset-claims` and `check-changeset-overwrite`: reports only, judged above.
- **Targeted eslint** over the six touched TS files: 0 errors. Each edited source file has the same warning count as at base. The new test carries 2 `any` warnings, the same two the objectui#7353 listener carries. This is a targeted run, not the repo lint, which CI owns.
- **NOT MEASURED:** `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples`. They exited 2, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because they need a 34-package build. They compile `ts`/`tsx` fences only; this branch edits no such fence and moves no published type.
- **Not reached:** `check:component-surface-parity` and `check:sdui-registration-pins`. No registration input moves.

## Acceptance notes

- **Chrome.** A retired dataset-less `metric` tile (and a typeless one) draws no heading, as the retired legacy-shape metric tile already does. Giving retired tiles Card chrome would move the legacy shape too. Not done; the report carries it as an open question.
- **`DashboardGridLayout.tsx` line addresses.** The one cross-file line address in the paragraph this branch edits was replaced by a symbol citation. Eleven others stay, in the props docblock and the render-site comment. Two of them also carry content that is stale at base: the sibling's `as any` read of `dataset`, and a second fork in the sibling's self-contained branch. Their repair is a content correction outside this card. Carrier: none.
- **`packages/sdui-parser/src/dashboard-widget-options.ts`.** Its scope note lists `object-metric` among the legacy inline spread targets, which no longer holds for the metric family. It is a comment in a package outside this card's surface. Carrier: none.
- **`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx`.** `ObjectMetricBlock`'s docblock names "the dashboard grid path" as a props-only host; no dashboard path builds the node now. Comment only. Carrier: none.
- **`packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`.** A comment there cites `isObjectProvider` as how a metric's `groupBy` arrives. It is a dated measurement (2026-09-08) and is left as written.
